messages.subject: Delivery scheduling problem
messages.body:
Hello,

I wanted to let you know about the delivery on my last rental. The driver came at completely the wrong time and I had to rearrange my whole day waiting around. This was a scheduling mistake on your end.

I've been a customer since 2016 and this is really disappointing.

Esko Väyrynen

messages.subject: Re: Delivery scheduling problem
messages.body:
Hi Esko,

I looked into this and you're right, it was a scheduling mix-up on our side. That shouldn't have happened and I'm sorry you had to waste your time waiting.

To make it right — your next order will include free delivery, on us. Just mention this email when you book and we'll make sure the delivery fee is waived.

Best regards,
Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Delivery scheduling problem
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm placing a new order and would like to confirm that the free delivery Petri Isokangas promised me is applied. He said the delivery fee would be waived on my next order because of the scheduling problem.

Please confirm.

Esko Väyrynen
